content.study:
Section 87 — historical and judicial status

Section 87 was inserted in 2019 to prescribe a transitional rule for the 2015 amendments. The Supreme Court in Hindustan Construction Company Ltd. v. Union of India struck section 87 down as unconstitutional. Accordingly, section 87 must be treated as a historical provision and not as the current governing transitional rule.

The repository should preserve the provision for legislative history but should not present it as operative law. The current transitional analysis must instead be made from the applicable amendment provisions, savings provisions and binding Supreme Court authority.
